_comment: Canonical contract address registry (Issue #881). One entry per network, generated/updated at deploy time from deployments/<network>.json and validated against deployments/<network>.manifest.json. Tooling and operators should read this file (via scripts/deployment_registry.ts) instead of grepping ad-hoc state files. 'address' is null until the contract has been deployed on that network. 'invariants' declares the versioned invariant snapshot set (Issue #1086) that deployment smoke tests assert immediately after initialization and after representative mutations; each entry names the invariant category, the read method used to observe it, and the expected value so failures can identify the violated invariant and contract address.

authorization.description: Only the configured admin/owner may perform privileged mutations.

balances.description: Tracked balances equal the sum of deposits minus withdrawals after representative mutations.

configuration.description: Configuration parameters match the values supplied at initialization.

version.description: On-chain contract version matches the version recorded in this registry.
